tools.name: search_iranian_law
tools.description: Search the text of Iranian statutes and regulations (قوانین و مقررات) published by Dadras and get the best-matching articles, each with an excerpt of its text, a note when it is repealed or old, and its dadrasai.com link. tools.name: get_law_article
tools.description: Read the full text of one article of an Iranian statute or regulation, word for word, with its law, the details on its page, a warning when it is marked repealed, and its dadrasai.com link. tools.name: find_law
tools.description: Find Iranian laws and regulations by their title, or part of it, in Dadras's library: up to 10 matches, best first, each with its slug, number of articles and dadrasai.com page. Use it when the user names a law («قانون صدور چک», «مدنی») and its exact title or slug is needed, before list_law_articles

tools.name: list_law_articles
tools.description: List the articles of one Iranian law in order, 50 per page, each with its title and slug, headed by the law's article count and number of pages. tools.name: explain_legal_term
tools.description: Explain what a Persian legal term means — «مهرالمثل», «اعسار», «قیم», «سرقفلی» — from Dadras's legal glossary: up to three distinct definitions, each with the article it explains and that article's dadrasai.com link. Use it when the question is what a legal word means; for the rules that apply to it

tools.name: calculate_late_payment
tools.description: Compute late-payment damages (خسارت تأخیر تأدیه, article 522 of the Civil Procedure Code) on a debt in rial between the month it fell due and the month it is paid, from the Central Bank's monthly price index.
